task.description: OTP-idiom/scope-creep/decision-record hard gate on ISS-0534's auth pipeline logging fix.

result.note: Scope clean via git show --stat: exactly 2 files, auth_pipeline.ex (+4/-1) and the new test file (+41); the {:error, {:provision, reason}} clause still ends in the byte-identical reject(conn, 500, ...) call; no touch to req021-auth-plug-pipeline.md or a Keycloak-volume note. Idiom: require Logger placement mirrors definitions.ex:223's convention, message format matches definitions.ex:964-967's inspected-reason idiom exactly; :error level (vs definitions.ex's :warning) justified since this path returns 500 (server-side fault) vs definitions.ex's 422 (client-correctable rejection). Decision-record consistency independently re-verified: req021-auth-plug-pipeline.md SS5.4 only constrains the response BODY (no changeset detail in the response), says nothing about server-side logs; OQ-9's settled divergence is specifically about returning 500 instead of a pre-JIT fallback, untouched by this diff -- additive logging does not reopen or contradict either decision. Test quality confirmed genuine and deterministic: pre-seeds a colliding User row under a different external identity via User.jit_changeset/2, verified against identity.ex:1498-1533 that identity_matches?/2 being false propagates the real {:error, changeset} unconditionally -- no race, no mocking; correctly wraps only the pipeline call in ExUnit.CaptureLog.capture_log/1, asserts response and log content appropriately inside/outside the capture block. Regression check independently confirmed: re-ran admission_pipeline_test.exs directly, 3/8 passed 5 failed, root cause is Letflow.TenantFixture.provisioned_tenant!/1 reporting versions_missing=[20260907020001] despite the migration file existing and being listed in manifest_versions -- a tenant-provisioning/migration-fixture gap entirely orthogonal to AuthPipeline, 100% reproducible independent of this diff. Real runs quoted: mix compile --warnings-as-errors clean; mix format --check-formatted clean; mix test test/letflow/plugs/auth_pipeline_test.exs test/letflow/plugs/auth_pipeline_configurable_verifier_test.exs -- 14 passed. TEST-DESIGNER/TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR skipped per established session precedent -- ELIXIR-DEV's own regression test is already comprehensive for this single-clause fix and REVIEWER independently verified its quality above. NOTE FOR ORCH: the admission_pipeline_test.exs migration-fixture gap (versions_missing=[20260907020001]) is a real, reproducible, pre-existing bug worth its own tracked issue -- not filed by REVIEWER, flagged here per No Issue Left Local-Only.
